chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Abdullah, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the pelting of the Jamarat, he (peace be upon him) said to him: 'With each pebble he pelts with, a major destructive sin is erased from him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for throwing pebbles at the Jamarat during Hajj?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the immense spiritual reward of the Jamarat ritual, where each pebble cast expiates a major, destructive sin (kabirah muqirah). This act serves as a tangible manifestation of divine mercy, transforming the physical struggle of Hajj into a means of profound spiritual purification and forgiveness of grave sins.
